OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY.description: abuse.ch Auth-Key (community mode), available at https://auth.abuse.ch. Optional when Spamhaus credentials are set.

URLHAUS_SPAMHAUS_USERNAME.description: Username of the Spamhaus abuse.ch API account (commercial mode), from the Spamhaus Customer Portal. Needs `spamhaus_password`.

URLHAUS_SPAMHAUS_PASSWORD.description: Password of the Spamhaus abuse.ch API account (commercial mode). Needs `spamhaus_username`.

URLHAUS_CSV_URL.description: Override of the URLhaus CSV export URL. Defaults to https://urlhaus-api.abuse.ch/v2/files/exports/<AUTH-KEY>/recent.csv, built from `auth_key`. The retired public URL (https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/downloads/...) is ignored.

URLHAUS_SPAMHAUS_IMPORT_FROM.description: With the commercial API, where the first run starts, as an ISO-8601 date or duration. Later runs start from the last imported URL.

URLHAUS_IMPORT_OFFLINE.description: Import URLs marked as 'offline' in addition to 'online'.

URLHAUS_THREATS_FROM_LABELS.description: Create relationships to existing threats based on URL tags.
